item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:45 HKT 01/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southwesterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the next few days. It will be persistently hot with a few showers over the region. A trough of low pressure is expected to linger over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week and bring thundery showers.

Weather: Hot with sunny periods and a few showers.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
